messages:
maria: Quick heads-up: night cutover for kernel+quant bundle in ~30m (23:40 UTC). Starting checklist here.

vince: on it for monitoring + rollback.

maria: Checklist:
- confirm artifact checksum on all regions
- kernel ABI vs runtime compatibility checks
- staged slices: 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%
- release notes draft: https://redwood.internal/ops/release/1739 (working)

kelly: Rollback triggers I care about:
- 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m
- p50 latency up >35% for 5m
- kv cache miss >20% -> cost spike

oz: add thermal OOM watch: GPU mem pressure >90% on >10% hosts -> immediate rollback.

deploybot: scheduled deploy by maria at 2026-03-21T23:40:00Z to pool:night-quant. Preflight: checksum ok, env config match, canary slice ready.

maria: Staging canaries passed with matmul-quant-v3. We saw small logit rounding diffs vs float32 but within eval thresholds. Watch for decode distribution shifts.

vince: Pinning dashboards to new trace ids; will escalate on tail regressions even if p50 is fine.

kelly: Release note blurb: "minor decoding distribution shift in tight prompts; canned evals pass." Keep public wording conservative.

maria: Deploy command when ready:
```
deploybot deploy --bundle night-quant-1739 --slice 2% --steps 2,10,50,100 --notify @eng-oncall
```

oz: I'll run thermal sweep 10m before deploy and again at canary step. If any host >85% mem, drain it.

vince: Ops rule: if rollback happens, no auto-retry. Manual investigation, then redeploy prior bundle with --force after approvals.

maria: Post-deploy chores: finalize release notes with perf numbers, tag commit, notify CS + SRE.

kelly: Phone on. Ping me if deploybot sticky-pins or >1% sustained errors. :phone: :thumbsup:

maria: Launching slice 2% in ~10m — will post status.

deploybot: deploy step started: slice 2% -> 2026-03-21T23:49:30Z. Preflight 18s.

vince: small p95 bump ~10s after cutover, watching.

maria: Hold 3m. If stable, move to 10%. If not, rollback and collect traces.

deploybot: canary @2%: errors 0.12%, p50 +8%, p95 +14%. Next step pending.

maria: One more minute then advance.

vince: advance from monitoring.

kelly: advance from me.

deploybot: advancing to 10% -> 2026-03-21T23:55:12Z.

maria: Keep eyes on kv cache: earlier rollout had a config mismatch that killed hit-rate. KV miss >15% for 5m -> rollback.

oz: thermal good at 10%, no host >80%.

deploybot: metrics @10%: errors 0.18%, p50 +9%, p95 +16%, kv_miss 6%.

vince: stable; request move to 50%.

maria: pushing to 50% now.

deploybot: advancing to 50% -> 2026-03-22T00:03:44Z.

vince: saw a cluster with p95 +28% for ~2m at 50%, then decayed. Traces point to longer decode loops on a small subset.

maria: hold at 50% for 10m to collect traces. If recurrence, rollback.

kelly: incident doc IR-1739 created to capture traces and touchpoints.

maria: After full rollout we'll run a prod prompt eval suite; if any critical-intent eval regresses >2% we'll flag a quality rollback.

deploybot: rollout complete -> 100% at 2026-03-22T00:18:02Z. Post-deploy smoke checks passed.

vince: monitoring steady at 100% for 6m: p50 +7%, p95 +12%, errors 0.15% (within thresholds).

maria: Great work. Finalize notes and tag bundle. Leaving thread open 24h for regressions.

kelly: Notifying CS and prepping customer-safe blurb.

oz: Scheduling 48h postmortem for the small tail blip.

maria: thanks team :tada:
